deadlines.title: EU member states must offer a certified EUDI Wallet
deadlines.description: All 27 EU member states must make at least one certified EUDI Wallet available to citizens and businesses.

deadlines.title: Regulated private sector must accept the EUDI Wallet
deadlines.description: Banks and large online platforms must accept the EUDI Wallet for authentication.

deadlines.title: Germany's national wallet ("d-you") targeted launch
deadlines.description: Germany's state-driven EUDI Wallet, branded "d-you", is targeted to launch nine days after the EU-wide deadline.

notes.text: EEA-EFTA states (Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway) have a one-year extension.

sources.label: signicat.com — EUDI Wallets: only one year to launch

spotlightCountries.name: Netherlands
spotlightCountries.headline: Public NL Wallet in development — delay risk flagged
spotlightCountries.detail: A public NL Wallet is in active development with public testing underway. Independent analysis suggests an initial release may not satisfy the full requirement set by the EU deadline, with a fuller version possibly landing sometime in 2027.
spotlightCountries.sourceLabel: namirial.com — EUDI Wallet: how prepared are the various EU countries?

spotlightCountries.name: Germany
spotlightCountries.headline: Targeting national wallet launch 2 January 2027
spotlightCountries.detail: Germany's state-driven wallet, "d-you", is set to launch nine days after the EU-wide deadline, with around 40 partners from business, government, and academia providing services at launch.
spotlightCountries.sourceLabel: ID Tech Wire — Germany Names EUDI Wallet "d-you"

spotlightCountries.name: France
spotlightCountries.headline: Early pilot: "France Identité"
spotlightCountries.detail: France Identité is already a live production service, expanding its functionality and ecosystem integration as it becomes an official EUDI Wallet, and has started initial tests with relying parties.
spotlightCountries.sourceLabel: namirial.com — EUDI Wallet: how prepared are the various EU countries?

spotlightCountries.name: Austria
spotlightCountries.headline: Early pilot: "eAusweise"
spotlightCountries.detail: Austria benefits from the combination of ID Austria and eAusweise, giving the country an already-functioning mobile credential system to build the EUDI Wallet on top of.
spotlightCountries.sourceLabel: namirial.com — EUDI Wallet: how prepared are the various EU countries?

spotlightCountries.name: Italy
spotlightCountries.headline: Early pilot: "IT-Wallet"
spotlightCountries.detail: The IT-Wallet is explicitly designed as a national wallet system, letting citizens access it using existing CIE or SPID credentials — built on already-established national identity infrastructure.
spotlightCountries.sourceLabel: namirial.com — EUDI Wallet: how prepared are the various EU countries?

spotlightCountries.name: Poland
spotlightCountries.headline: Integrating into mObywatel — version migration risk
spotlightCountries.detail: Poland has paired a substantial installed base — mObywatel 2.0 has almost 10 million users — with a public commitment to integrate the EUDI Wallet by end of 2026. The transition to version 3.0 could cause significant delays.
spotlightCountries.sourceLabel: namirial.com — EUDI Wallet: how prepared are the various EU countries?

uk.name: United Kingdom
uk.headline: ECCTA identity verification — most directors and PSCs still unverified
uk.detail: By the end of June 2026, only 55% of directors, 50% of LLP members, and 42% of people with significant control (PSCs) had informed Companies House of their verified identity, under the Economic Crime and Corporate Transparency Act.
uk.sourceLabel: PKF Francis Clark, citing Companies House management information (published 11 Aug 2026)

us.name: United States
us.headline: Meanwhile, in the US: BOI reporting rolled back
us.detail: FinCEN permanently removed Beneficial Ownership Information (BOI) reporting requirements for US companies and US persons, effective 14 August 2026. Only foreign reporting companies are still required to report.
